svg.title: stars: ZSeven-W/openpencil
svg.desc: A chart artifact, using primer genome.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Porcelain-style chart card with a pale surface, thin cobalt/variant series line, subdued grid, and live pill. The chart should compare directly with the specimen's soft report-card treatment.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: The same primer chart layout runs for light and dark substrates; light variants inject paper gradient, border, shadow, and accent roles, while the render engine computes axes, labels, milestones, and endpoints.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Kept the chart static except for compositor-safe line draw and endpoint opacity pulse; this preserves GitHub README compatibility while giving up richer geometric animation that would complicate reduced motion.
